summary.en: A small three-story house is put up for rent in the neighborhood and the Detective Boys decide to pass by it on the way home from school. Haibara tricks the real estate agent into giving them a tour of the inside and Conan notices that he could see Kogoro's detective agency from the third floor window. The next day, they discover the house has been sold to an old couple and Conan finds them suspicious. He follows the old man to China town and into an antique shop. The old man is talking with an old Chinese man. Conan is discovered and flees from the scene. Later that day, Conan notices that the house has a camera directed towards the Mouri detective agency and deduces the old couples are people using a disguise.
